decisions: Provider link confirmation is signed for five minutes and bound to the exact provider/session; unlink revokes rather than deletes identity history and rotates the current session atomically
risks: A valid five-minute link confirmation can start more than one bounded OAuth attempt before expiry; every resulting state remains one-time and initiation limits apply. Existing duplicate active user/provider rows must be reviewed before production index creation.
